name: fintech-institutional
title: Fintech Institutional
description: Deep forest-navy authority with high-legibility numeric hierarchy, restrained brass and emerald semantics, and rigorous financial data structure.

typography.fontFamily: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
typography.monospaceFamily: IBM Plex Mono, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace

rules: Treat every financial value as auditable data with tabular figures, explicit currency, sign, and timestamp.
Use deep forest surfaces and restrained brass for institutional hierarchy, not luxury decoration.
Emerald indicates positive or verified states and always carries text or icon reinforcement.
Build dense sixteen-column account and portfolio layouts with exact numeric alignment.
Surface elevation follows canvas, account panel, elevated review, interactive, and border tokens.
Never hide fees, risk, or destructive consequences in muted microcopy.
Confirmation workflows expose totals, accounts, timing, and recovery paths before submission.
Use one-pixel borders before shadow and preserve contrast across both light and dark themes.
Charts provide readable axes, units, and tabular alternatives rather than decorative gradients.
Motion confirms transaction state without implying success before server confirmation.
